items.title: Al Gallodoro Interview, 1966-05-10
items.q: That's when I was doing Percy Faith's Carnation Milk Hour.

ctx.x: Yeah, sure. For every building you've got here, we built 15 there. This is no exaggeration. Park Avenue is just nothing but steel buildings. All your big companies. So, anyway, I was with NBC for about two years and a half. Toscanini. Then I left and started to freelance. And, oh, God. That's when I was doing Percy Faith's Carnation Milk Hour. And Antonini, who's with CBS, conductor there. And various recordings, various movies.
Could you name some of those in the story?
